open.speaker: kid
lines: You the monster people? I saw it. Red eyes. Big as a truck. Out at the igloos.

passives.line: He rehearsed that. He is waiting for you to be impressed, and a little worried that you will be.
Big as a truck. At the diner it was a Buick. Stories grow in the retelling, but this one grew in a day and a half.
He is cold. He has been standing on this corner a while. Somebody told him to stand here and say that to strangers.

options.text: Big as a truck. What kind of truck?
You're freezing. Hot chocolate at Rosie's, on us.
We're from the paper. A dollar a quote.
Those are bicycle reflectors in your pocket.

truck.speaker: kid
lines: Okay, a car. A big car. It was dark.
First rule of the trade, kid. Never give a size.

cocoa.speaker: kid
lines: I'm not supposed to go in Rosie's. Marlene says I'm bad for business.
...With marshmallows? Okay. Okay, but I'm not saying anything in there. Bobby's cousin eats there.
Two marshmallows and he'll say plenty. I raised four.

dollar.speaker: kid
lines: A dollar? Bobby only gives a dollar. You give two and I'll say it was purple.
...Wait. You're not from the paper. Okay. Okay, Bobby gives me a dollar to say I saw it. I didn't see it.
I saw the dog, though. The big one with the wrong legs. Out behind the church. I'm not going back there for any dollar.

dollar_fail.speaker: kid
lines: My mom says don't talk to reporters. She says the reporters are why Grandpa don't go to the diner.

passives.line: You told a ten-year-old you were a reporter, in this town. There was no worse badge to flash.

reflectors.speaker: kid
lines: They're Bobby's. I'm supposed to put 'em on the new board tonight. He gave me a flashlight too.
I'm not going. I'm not going out there again. Not after Thursday. You can tell him, I don't care.
Thursday. Something was out there Thursday that scared the kid off the prank. That's worth more than the prank.

reflectors_fail.speaker: kid
lines: They're for my bike. Everybody's got 'em. Harmon's sells 'em.
...You want to see something real, go behind the church. The lot. Don't tell Reverend Addy I said so. He doesn't like people back there since Thursday.

bored.speaker: kid
lines: Fine. It ain't out at the igloos. That's what Bobby wants everybody to think. It's in town. It's been in town since Thursday. That's all, I'm done, bye.
That's the first thing anyone's told us today that they weren't paid to say.

hub.speaker: kid
lines: What? I gotta be home by dark. Mom's rule since Thursday.
